events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 507 PM CDT, a confirmed tornado was located 6 miles east of
Milberger, or 12 miles north of Hoisington, moving northeast at 30
mph.

HAZARD...Damaging tornado.

SOURCE...Weather spotters confirmed tornado.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree damage is
likely.

This tornadic thunderstorm will remain over mainly rural areas of
southeastern Russell and north central Barton Counties.

This includes Interstate 70 near Mile Marker 195.

events.region: Gove, KS; Logan, KS; Sheridan, KS; Thomas, KS
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southwestern Sheridan County in northwestern Kansas...
Southern Thomas County in northwestern Kansas...
Western Gove County in west central Kansas...
Logan County in west central Kansas...

* WHEN...Until 900 AM CDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 500 PM CDT, the Logan County Emergency Manager reported water
over a few county road ways. Minor flooding is already occurring.
Between 2 and 4 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 3 inches may occur tonight. If
this rain occurs, expect more widespread flooding issues.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Oakley, Grinnell, Winona, Monument, Russell Springs, Mingo, The
Monument Rocks and Angelus.

Southwestern Glasscock County in western Texas...
Southeastern Midland County in western Texas...
Northwestern Reagan County in western Texas...
Northeastern Upton County in western Texas...
